PLASTICS BOTTLES FOR POTABLE WATER — 
SPECIFICATION 


( Second Revision ) 


1 SCOPE 


L1 This standard prescribes the requirements tor plastic 
hottles used tor carrying/stoning drinking water 


1.2 This standard does not include plasues insulated 
bottles

3 TERMINOLOGY 


For the purpose of this standard the definitions given in 
[S 7408 (Part 1) and IS 7019 shall apply 


4 REQUIREMENTS 
4.1 Material 


4.£.1 All Components of water bottle (including the bottle 
itself, the cap and the drinking cup) which come in contact 
with water shall be manufactured from HDPE PVC PP 
and PET contorming to the following Indian Standards 
respectively 


a) TS 10146 
b) IS 10151, 
c) IS 0910, and 
d) IS 12252 


IS 8688 : 2004 


4.1.2 Phe bottle shall be coloured, pgmented and opaque 
The colourants and prgments used shall conform to the 
limuts and tolerances prescribed in FS 9833 


4.1.3 The hanging cord or straps, if provided, shall be of 
a fl@obte matenal which is not affected by water 


4,2 Capacity 


4.2. The bottles shall be manufactured tn nominal 
capacity of SOO mE 750 mt, 1 000 ml and 1 500 mt or any 
other capacity as agreed to between the purchaser and 
the supplier 


4.2.2 The brimful capacity shall exceed the nominal 
capacity by a nunimum of 5 percent Phe brimtul capacity 
shall be determined by the method prescribed in IS 2798 


4.3 Design 


The bottle design shall be such that itis stable when kept 
moverhiical postion The shape of the bottle shall be as 
agiecd fo between the purchaser and the supplier 


4.4 Neck Size 


The neck shall be of nomina! size 24 mun, 28 mim, 31 5 
minor tomm pilfer proof finish [yee IS 75] ] (Part 4) 


4.5 Cap 


The bottle shall be Closed with a surtable closure made of 
metabor plastics and pier proofin character Additional 
protection shall be made by using printed shrink sleeves 
on similar measures 


4.6 Cup 


the hotde may be provided with a drinking cup, which 
shall Geon to the bottle neck 


4.7 Hanging Cord or Strap 


A flexible hanging cord or strap to hang the bottle on 
shoulder or peg may be provided with the bottle Et may 
be hinged or strapped to the body of the botde 


4.8 Workmanship and Finish 


The bottle stall be manulactured in accordance with good 
Manufacturing practices These shall be free trom 
manufacturing defects such as foreign particles, burnt, 
oxidized or unbomogenized matter, flash, rocking bottom, 
Sharp edges, ete 


4.9 Odour 


The bottles shall be free from any odour, dirt or dust 
parucles 


4.10 Mass 


Phe mass of the bottles shall be as agreed to between the 
purchaser and the suppher There shall be a tolerance af 
+ 5 percent on the agreed mass 


4.11 Dimensions 


The height and diameter of the bottle shall be as agreed 
to between the purchaser and the supplier The tolerance 
on agreed dimensions shall be as follows 


a) Up to and including 100 mm +145 mm 


b) Over 100 mm and up to 200 mm +20mm 


co) Over 200 mm +25 mm 


4.12 Overall Migration 


The hint of overall migration with water when tested as 
prescribed m FS 9845 shall not exceed 60 mg/l of simulant 
and 10 mg/dm? of the surface of the Container 


4.13 Tests 
4.13.1 Closure Leakage Test 


The bottle shall be tiled to its nominal capacity wih 
coloured water at ambient temperature and closed tightly 
with the cap) The stopper plug, where provided shall he 
pressed Oght in postion and the cap shall be fitted tht 
by hand The filled boule shall be kept in vertcally 
inverted position over a piece of blotung paper fora period 
of 30 mim At the end of the test, the Closure shall not 
show any leakage of water 


4.13.2 Drop Impait Test 


Fhe bottle with the cap but without the drinking cup, when 
subjected to the drop test as prescribed in IS 2798 shall 
not show any sign of cracking Slizht deshaping of the 
body shall not render the bottles unacceptable in the test 


4.13.3 Hanging Cord/Strap Strength Fost 


The hanging cord/sttap shall be able to support the mass 
equal to 3 tunes the mass of filled bottle tor FO min without 
breaking The elongation under load shall not exceed 10 
percent of the total length of the cord Forttal stretching 
due to unwinding of the cord shall not be taken as 
elongation tor the purpose of calculation 


5 WATER POTABILITY TEST 


Potable water stored in the bottle for 72 h shall not acquire 
any unpleasant odour or bilter taste or shall not impair 
the health when tested according to the method preseribed 
in Annex A

6.1.3 The product must display a histol critical ingredients 
iy descending order of quantity present expressed as 
percent of the total The list of such ingredtents shall be 
idenufied by Bureau of Indian Standards 


6.1.4 The product packaging shall display in briet the 
criteria based on which the product has Deen labelled as 
Fovironment F nendly’ 


6.1.5 The matenal used for product packaging shall be 
recyclable or biodegradable 


6.1.6 It shall also surtably mention that ECO Mark label 
ts appheable only to the packaging matenal/package 1 
content is not separately covered under FCO Mark H

ANNEX A 
(Clause 5) 


METHOD OF TEST FOR POTABILITY OF WATER 
STORED IN PLASTICS BOTTLES 


A-I GENERAL 


A-1.1 Odour of water, though very important, cannot 
be determined in absolute umts Olfactory sense, which 
is mostsensitive means of detecung small concentration 
of odiferous substances, lacks precision and 
mathematical expression nevertheless a quantitative test 
n prescribed 


A-b2 The water for testing shall be clear and fresh free 
from any suspended of dissolved impurities H 
necessary it may be filtered he fore storage 


A-2 PROCEDURE 


Heat the water to a temperature of 38 + 2°C and till the 
bottles to its nominal capacity and close tightly with the 
cap Keep the bottles at 38 + 2 C for a period of 72 h at 
ambient temperature 


A-3 OBSERVATIONS 


At the end of 72 h the water shall not give any unpleasant 
odour or taste Any vistble fungus growth in water shall 
render the boule maternal unfit lor use
